name: writing-skills
description: Creates or updates professional-grade agent skills (SKILL.md + optional scripts/references/assets) with strict validation and an iterative generator↔critic workflow. Use when: you want a new skill, want to refactor an existing skill for clarity/token-efficiency, or want to reach an A-grade rubric score. Not for reviewing or grading a skill (use reviewing-skills), or for authoring rubrics (writing-rubrics), specs (writing-specs), designs (writing-designs), or AGENTS.md (writing-agents-md).
